newsitem.title: USA: Packaging Research to miss interest payment.
newsitem.headline: Packaging Research to miss interest payment.

text.p: Packaging Research Corp said on Thursday it was not able to make the semi-annual interest payment on its subordinated convertible debentures due to a default under senior debt.
The company said it is in the process of attempting to remedy the senior debt default and will resume payments under the subordinated debentures as quickly as possible.

Interest due September 1 on the public debentures amounts to $72,000, said company controller Sue Lemons. No one from the company was available to say when it defaulted on the senior debt or what the amount of the debt is.
Packaging Research is a manufacturer and distributor of precision, high-speed food-processing equipment and the holding company of Premium pasta sauce manufacturer Mama Rizzo's Inc.
